TRY: Network speed tests

The available speed of network connections depend on many factors. A starter spot is to compare LAN and WLAN speeds.

There may be hidden adapters due to network or computer configuration factors such as a VPN or applied virtualization. Add ‑includehidden to reveal all interfaces.

The LinkSpeed shows the adapter speed capability.

# Show name and link speed
Get-NetAdapter | select name, LinkSpeed
